objective: GET /api/health reports the commit the server is running (FR-26, #58), in both the healthy and the unhealthy response, so the client dashboard can confirm which deploy is live. Success: a health response carries `commit` (the SHA string) when one is known and `commit: null` when none is, the status code rules (200 ok / 503 not ok) are unchanged, and the probe still does no extra engine work.
contract:
FR-26 (docs/requirements.md, A7): `GET /api/health` reports the commit the server is running, so an outside consumer can confirm which deploy is live. When no commit is known (local runs), it says so instead of failing.
NFR-15: the response holds versions and counts only (no other new data).
Decisions (coordinator):
- Add `commit: string | null` to BOTH variants of `HealthStatus` in apps/server/src/health.ts: `{ ok: true; engine: "ready"; commit: string | null } | { ok: false; reason: string; commit: string | null }`. The no-probe fallback in apps/server/src/app.ts:102-105 does not need to change (it is only used when no probe is configured); leave app.ts alone.
- `createHealthProbe` gets an optional `commit?: string | null` dep. When the dep is absent, default to `process.env.RENDER_GIT_COMMIT`, treating unset or empty/whitespace as null. Trim it. Do not shorten it.
- Render sets RENDER_GIT_COMMIT on the running service (the full 40-char SHA, to the coordinator's understanding); nothing else reads it today.
- Read the env once when the probe is created, not per request.
Tests: existing health tests live in apps/server/test/deploy.test.ts. Add yours there or in a new apps/server/test/health-commit.test.ts. Cases: dep given -> ok response carries it; dep null -> commit null; env var set/unset/blank when dep absent (restore process.env after); unhealthy (engine timeout or store error) response also carries commit; HTTP: 200 and 503 bodies both include commit.
Gate at base a2f2b19 (run by the coordinator): `pnpm test` -> Tests 1200 passed (1200); `pnpm typecheck` clean.
negative: Do not edit files outside scope, docs, config, .github, root files or the lockfile.
Do not edit apps/server/src/app.ts, main.ts, games.ts or store.ts (a parallel spoke owns them this round).
Do not make the health probe call the engine more than it does today.
rubric: Tests first (red then green) for: commit from dep, null dep, env set / unset / blank, commit present on an unhealthy response, and both HTTP status bodies.
pnpm test and pnpm typecheck clean from the repo root.
